name: Word Counter
description: Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs instantly. Real-time stats with reading time estimates.
longDescription: Word Counter provides real-time text statistics as you type. Counts words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, and unique words. Estimates reading and speaking time. Keyword density analysis for SEO. Clean, distraction-free interface. Works offline after first load.
pricingDetails: Completely free with all features. No ads, no tracking, no account needed.
